In [[mathematics]], a '''topological abelian group''', or '''TAG''', is a [[topological group]] that is also an [[abelian group]].
That is, a TAG is both a [[Group (algebra)|group]] and a [[topological space]], the group operations are [[Continuous (topology)|continuous]], and the group's binary operation is [[commutative]].

The theory of topological groups applies also to TAGs, but more can be done with TAGs. [[Locally compact space|Locally compact]] TAGs, in particular, are used heavily in [[harmonic analysis]].
